proof_review: Tree leaf elimination forces every coefficient of a tree-supported circulation to zero; tree incidence columns are independent. All incidence columns sum to zero, furnishing the V-1 upper bound for a connected graph.

Rooting potentials removes only a constant from gradient coordinates. Connectivity proves injectivity of the V-1 remaining potential coordinates, establishing cut dimension without a hidden transpose-rank theorem.

Each fundamental cycle has +1 on its own chord and zero on other chords. This proves independence. Subtracting chord coefficients from any circulation leaves a tree circulation, which vanishes; hence generation.
Wrap transform is invertible over the reals/rationals: d9=-sum(d1..d8), wj=W/9+dj. Integer input reconstruction imposes compatibility rather than nine arbitrary integer output coordinates.
For any flow, chord-derived s is a circulation and r=f-s is tree-supported; f=s+r and Dr=Df. This retains every noncycle component without implying an orthogonal decomposition.
The resulting finite graph counts and reversible coordinates do not themselves define a dynamics or a named algebra action.
